name: Content Central
description_en: Content Central is Ademero’s document management system for capturing, indexing, retrieving and routing business records. Catalogs and document types connect files to fields, permissions and processes. It can run in the vendor cloud or on Windows servers with SQL Server, while people use a browser. CapturePoint scanning, Paige page-processing plans and Cortexa AI have separate product scopes; their offers should not be merged into a Content Central price or entitlement.
description_zh: Content Central 是 Ademero 用于采集、索引、检索和流转业务记录的文档管理系统。目录与文档类型将文件连接到字段、权限及流程。它可运行于厂商云端，或使用 SQL Server 的 Windows 服务器，用户通过浏览器工作。CapturePoint 扫描、Paige 按页处理方案及 Cortexa AI 各有产品范围，不能把它们的报价或权益混为 Content Central 的条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Capture choices determine immediate filing or Coding Queue work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 采集选择决定直接归档还是进入编码队列。

core_features.explanation_en: Approval routing and group sign-off thresholds are configured for filed document types.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为已归档文档类型配置审批路由与组签核阈值。

core_features.explanation_en: Major versions carry file changes; minor entries record surrounding actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 主版本对应文件改变，次版本记录相关操作。

en: Evaluate synthetic purchase orders from indexing through group approval, revision and a separate restore-point check.
zh: 评估虚构采购单从索引、组审批至修订，并另行检查恢复点。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation only; no customer result or server operation.

Deployment.en: Vendor cloud or Windows/SQL Server on-premises with browser access; exact supported versions unverified.
Deployment.zh: 厂商云端或 Windows／SQL Server 本地部署，通过浏览器访问；精确受支持版本未核实。

steps.en: Define a document type, index fields, effective permissions, approval threshold and recovery owner before capturing sample records.
steps.zh: 采集样例前定义文档类型、索引字段、有效权限、审批阈值及恢复责任人。

integrations.scope: Capture and accounting/API/ODBC options advertised; no external connection, data mapping or export transaction tested.

items.en: No web undo for deletion; additive permissions require reviewing every granting source.
items.zh: 删除无网页撤销；累加权限需检查全部授权来源。

sections.title_en: Choose the document type before the automation
sections.title_zh: 自动化之前先定义文档类型
sections.en:
Content Central organizes captured records by catalogs, document types and index fields, then applies search, permissions and workflows. Cloud and on-premises deployment are both offered; the latter uses Windows and SQL Server and places backup/security work within the customer environment. A browser interface does not remove those server responsibilities.

For an editorial pilot, use synthetic purchase orders with supplier code, order number, amount and owner department. Define which field controls retrieval, filing and routing, then compare the stored record with its source. This is a document-process evaluation, not a claim that OCR output is correct or that an accounting transaction was posted. Adjacent CapturePoint and Cortexa capabilities need their own configuration and commercial scope. No application, database, scanner or AI connection was installed.
sections.zh:
Content Central 按目录、文档类型及索引字段组织采集记录，再应用检索、权限与工作流。它提供云端和本地部署；后者使用 Windows 与 SQL Server，备份及安全运营落在客户环境。浏览器界面不免除这些服务器责任。

编辑建议的试点可用虚构采购单，设置供应商代码、订单号、金额及所属部门。先定义哪些字段控制检索、归档和路由，再将存储记录与来源比较。这是文档流程评估，不代表 OCR 输出正确或会计交易已经入账。相邻 CapturePoint 与 Cortexa 能力需单独确定配置及商业范围。本研究未安装应用、数据库、扫描器或 AI 连接。

sections.title_en: One upload path indexes individually; another shares values
sections.title_zh: 一种上传逐份索引，另一种共用字段值
sections.en:
Capture New > Electronic handles one file with a choice to provide index values now, later in the Coding Queue or partly in each. The Folder Browser instead uploads several files into one folder with one document type and the same field values, without Coding Queue routing. Files over 2 GB and administrator-blocked formats can be rejected.

For the proposed purchase orders, a mixed batch with different suppliers or amounts belongs in a path that preserves per-document indexing. The convenience of dropping fifteen files into a folder does not make one entered supplier code correct for all fifteen. Verify both location and fields after capture, and distinguish an uploaded document waiting for coding from one already filed. No file upload was executed.
sections.zh:
Capture New > Electronic 每次处理一个文件，可选择立即提供索引值、稍后在编码队列填写，或两处分别填写部分。文件夹浏览器则把多个文件上传至一个文件夹，采用同一文档类型及相同字段值，不经过编码队列路由。超过 2 GB 的文件及管理员禁止的格式可能被拒绝。

建议采购单若供应商或金额各不相同，应使用保留逐份索引的路径。把十五个文件拖入文件夹很方便，但不代表输入的一份供应商代码适用于全部十五份。采集后应检查位置和字段，并区分上传后待编码与已经归档的文档。本研究未上传文件。

sections.title_en: A restrictive group cannot subtract another grant
sections.title_zh: 限制性组无法扣除其他授权
sections.en:
The permission guide describes additive grants from direct permissions, groups and document creator rights. Any granting source is enough; there is no deny that another group or direct setting can apply. Search, View and Browse are also separate permissions, and access to a document is distinct from membership in its approval path.

For the purchase-order pilot, check all groups of the external reviewer before interpreting a missing direct grant as protection. Test finding, opening, browsing, editing and deleting separately with synthetic records from two departments. A user who can find a result may still lack View; another with an unexpected group grant may retain Delete. Inspect effective rights and the business approval role independently before copying another employee’s setup. No user or group permission was changed.
sections.zh:
权限指南描述直接权限、组及文档创建者权限的累加授权。任一来源授予即可，没有能由另一个组或直接设置施加的 deny。Search、View 和 Browse 也分别授权；文档访问权与审批路径成员身份不同。

采购单试点应检查外部审阅者的全部组，再判断没有直接授权是否构成保护。用两个部门的虚构记录分别测试检索、打开、浏览、编辑与删除。用户可能找到结果却没有 View，也可能因未注意的组授权保留 Delete。复制其他员工设置前，应分别检查有效权限及业务审批角色。本研究未修改用户或组权限。

sections.title_en: A Coding Queue item has not entered approval
sections.title_zh: 编码队列项目尚未进入审批
sections.en:
Approval attaches to filed documents. An item waiting in the Coding Queue does not appear in an Approval Queue until committed to its catalog. Processes define an ordered path of users or groups, an entry point and optional automatic start. Multi group routing uses a sign-off threshold such as one, majority, a specified number or everyone; rejection has its own threshold.

For the proposed order, confirm indexing first, then trace entry into the selected process and the decision history. An all-members threshold can stall when someone leaves, so maintain group membership and backup responsibilities. Lower numeric process priority matters when enabled processes compete. Missing automatic entry may be a configuration choice, not a broken service. Do not equate a successful capture with completed approval. No process or approval was run.
sections.zh:
审批作用于已归档文档。项目仍在编码队列等待时，不会进入审批队列；提交至目录后才会。流程定义用户或组的有序路径、入口及可选自动启动。Multi 组路由采用一人、多数、指定人数或全员等签核阈值，拒绝也有独立阈值。

建议采购单测试应先确认索引，再追踪所选流程入口及决定历史。全员阈值可能因成员离职而停滞，需维护组成员及替补责任。多个启用流程竞争时，较小的优先级数值有意义。没有自动进入可能是配置选择，并非服务损坏。采集成功不等于审批完成。本研究未运行流程或审批。

sections.title_en: Releasing a lock and recovering old content are separate actions
sections.title_zh: 释放锁与恢复旧内容是不同操作
sections.en:
Checkout gives one editor exclusive change rights while others can view. Approval policy may refuse checkout, and properties are also locked unless an administrator permits changes. Check-in uploads the edited file as a new major version; Undo Check Out releases the lock without importing the downloaded edits. Forced administrator undo is not a merge of another editor’s work.

History distinguishes major file revisions from minor surrounding events. Only file-bearing rows can be downloaded. To make earlier content current, the documented path downloads that version and uploads it as a new revision, preserving intervening history rather than using one-click restore. For the pilot, compare the intended revision and its field values before and after that operation. History of changes does not substitute for the Event Viewer’s access records. No lock, undo, revision or restore was executed.
sections.zh:
签出使一位编辑者独占修改权，其他人仍可查看。审批政策可能拒绝签出；属性也会锁定，除非管理员允许修改。签入将编辑后的文件作为新主版本上传；Undo Check Out 释放锁，但不会导入下载副本的修改。管理员强制撤销并不是合并其他编辑者的工作。

历史区分文件主修订与周边操作的次版本事件，只有携带文件的行可下载。使旧内容再次成为当前版本的文档路径，是下载旧版再上传为新修订，保留中间历史，而非一键恢复。建议试点应比较操作前后的目标修订及字段值。变更历史不能替代事件查看器中的访问记录。本研究未执行锁定、撤销、修订或恢复。

sections.title_en: Diagnose the oldest watched-folder file before restarting
sections.title_zh: 重启前先检查监控文件夹最旧文件
sections.en:
The capture guide describes oldest-modified-first processing. If the service cannot open that first file exclusively because it is read-only or locked, it abandons the folder pass and retries; healthy later files can remain without their own errors. A file that opens but cannot be ingested follows a different path to Unprocessed. The service account also needs folder Modify rights.

For a synthetic capture test, identify one filename and modified timestamp, observe the service status and match the queue/log evidence before changing anything. Check whether a file is still being written and whether it was filed directly rather than sent to a personal or shared Coding Queue. SQL/time-out errors or a repeatedly stopping service require server diagnosis. Repeated restarts do not remove a file lock and can discard useful failure context. This research only read the guide; no server, file attribute or service was changed.
sections.zh:
采集指南描述按修改时间从旧到新处理。若首个文件因只读或被锁而无法独占打开，服务会放弃本次文件夹处理并重试，后续正常文件可能没有自身错误却一直等待。可打开但无法导入的文件则进入另一条 Unprocessed 路径。服务账户还需要文件夹 Modify 权限。

虚构采集测试应确定文件名及修改时间，观察服务状态并对照队列和日志，再作修改。应检查文件是否仍在写入，以及是否已经直接归档而未进入个人或共享编码队列。SQL／超时错误或服务反复停止需要服务器诊断。重复重启不消除文件锁，还可能丢失有用故障背景。本研究只读取指南，未修改服务器、文件属性或服务。

sections.title_en: Deletion has no web recycle bin
sections.en:
The deletion guide states that there is no web restore, recycle bin or undo, including for administrators. Deleted content’s files, versions and metadata move to a server-side Deleted Content area; recovery requires a server administrator to locate material and re-capture it. That safety net is different from restoring an intact application record.

Permission, checkout and active approval can block deletion. A batch is partial: blocked documents do not prevent others from being deleted, and results must be inspected per document. For an evaluation, first establish the real administrator recovery arrangement and a disposable synthetic record. Do not assume the resulting record preserves every link, routing state or audit relationship. Scheduled retention is a separate policy decision; this research did not delete any document or run a disposition job.
sections.zh:
删除指南明确没有网页恢复、回收站或撤销，管理员也一样。被删内容的文件、版本及元数据会移至服务器 Deleted Content 区域，恢复需要服务器管理员查找并重新采集。这种兜底不同于完整恢复应用记录。

权限、签出及活动审批均可阻止删除。批量删除可能部分成功：被阻止文档不会妨碍其他文档删除，需逐份检查结果。评估前应先明确真实管理员恢复安排，并准备可处置的虚构记录。不能假定新记录保留全部链接、路由状态或审计关系。按计划保留属于另一项政策决定，本研究未删除文档或运行处置任务。

sections.title_en: A SQL backup needs the matching document files
sections.title_zh: SQL 备份需要配套文档文件
sections.en:
The backup guide separates the SQL database from document files on disk. A complete restore point additionally includes document storage, search indexes, connection configuration and customized web settings. Database and document copies should come from the same window; mismatched snapshots can reference files that are missing or different.

For the on-premises pilot, have the responsible operator demonstrate a verified, off-server restore point and a recovery test in an appropriate separate environment. SQL checksum verification is useful evidence about the backup set, not proof that the whole document application can run after a loss. Indexes may be rebuilt, but time and capacity still matter. Establish acceptable recovery time and data loss for the chosen deployment rather than inferring either from a downloadable file. No SQL command, backup or restoration was run here.
sections.zh:
备份指南区分 SQL 数据库与磁盘上的文档文件。完整恢复点还需文档存储、检索索引、连接配置及定制网页设置。数据库与文档副本应来自同一时间窗口，不匹配快照可能引用缺失或不同的文件。

本地试点应由责任人员展示经过验证、保存在服务器之外的恢复点，并在适当独立环境测试恢复。SQL 校验和验证可说明备份集，但不证明整个文档应用在损失后可运行。索引可以重建，但时间及容量仍有影响。应为所选部署确定可接受恢复时间与数据损失，不能由可下载文件推断。本研究未运行 SQL 命令、备份或恢复。

sections.title_en: Get the Content Central quote, not another product’s page rate
sections.title_zh: 取得 Content Central 报价，勿套其他产品页费率
sections.en:
The current pricing page places Content Central under Get a quote. Its visible free/page-based Paige plans and per-PC CapturePoint 6 plan are different products. No Content Central numeric amount, seat minimum, capacity, license duration or universal trial duration was verified. Ask for the selected cloud or on-premises configuration, migration, storage, support and optional AI scope before estimating a total.

The general service terms reserve Ademero’s intellectual property, rather than grant an open-source license. For subscriptions they describe automatic renewal, cancellation with access through the current billing cycle and no refund of unused prepaid portions. Termination can end access and lead to data deletion after reasonable notice; exact timing and Content Central order terms still need confirmation. An on-premises installer is not an open-source grant. No quote, trial, purchase or agreement acceptance occurred.
sections.zh:
当前定价页把 Content Central 放在询价区。可见的 Paige 免费／按页套餐及 CapturePoint 6 每 PC 方案属于其他产品。未核实 Content Central 数值价格、最低席位、容量、许可时长或统一试用期。估算总额前，应取得所选云端或本地配置，以及迁移、存储、支持和可选 AI 范围。

通用服务条款保留 Ademero 知识产权，而非授予开源许可。订阅条款描述自动续期、取消后访问至当前计费周期结束，以及未用预付部分不退款。终止可结束访问，并在合理通知后删除数据，精确时间及 Content Central 订单条款仍需确认。本地安装包不代表开源授权。本研究未询价、试用、购买或接受协议。

seo.title_en: Content Central: Capture Queues, Additive Permissions and Recovery
seo.title_zh: Content Central：采集队列、累加权限与恢复
seo.description_en: Evaluate Content Central with indexing paths, approval entry, version history, watched-folder failures, deletion recovery and complete backup requirements.
seo.description_zh: 通过索引路径、审批入口、版本历史、监控文件夹故障、删除恢复及完整备份要求评估 Content Central。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Content Central for controlled document intake and approval.
secondary_questions: Does a folder batch preserve individual field values?
Can an administrator restore deleted content in the browser?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no measured search demand or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No server, SQL, scan, upload, field, group, approval, lock, service restart, deletion, backup, restore, AI, connector, quote or purchase operation executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行服务器、SQL、扫描、上传、字段、组、审批、锁定、服务重启、删除、备份、恢复、AI、连接器、询价或购买操作。

research_gaps.en: Exact order/license, supported server versions, cloud retention/exit, Deleted Content cleanup, re-capture fidelity, recovery targets and optional AI/provider terms remain unverified. Help applies to documented 7.x behavior, not every historic installation.
research_gaps.zh: 精确订单许可、受支持服务器版本、云端保留退出、Deleted Content 清理、重新采集保真、恢复目标及可选 AI／提供方条款未核实。帮助适用于文档所述 7.x 行为，不能泛化至全部历史安装。

research_gaps.en: Rollout speed, compliance, OCR accuracy and business outcomes were not independently validated. No current UI locale inventory or alternative relationships established.
research_gaps.zh: 上线速度、合规、OCR 准确性及业务结果未独立验证，未确立当前完整界面语言或替代关系。
